A bill for an act relating to health; requiring all pharmacies make ivermectin and hydroxychloroquine available without a prescription; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 151.01, by adding a subdivision; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 151.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 151.01, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 44.+]

[+Over-the-counter drug.+]

[+"Over-the-counter drug" means a drug legally available by retail sale that does not require a prescription or consultation with a pharmacist or other health care professional. +]

Sec. 2.

[+[151.411] OVER-THE-COUNTER SALE OF IVERMECTIN AND HYDROXYCHLORIOQUINE. +]

[+Notwithstanding any law to the contrary, a registered pharmacy or a licensed pharmacist must offer ivermectin and hydroxychloroquine tablets suitable for human use for sale as an over-the-counter drug. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to health; requiring all pharmacies make ivermectin and hydroxychloroquine available without a prescription; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 151.01, by adding a subdivision; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 151.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 151.01, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 44.

Over-the-counter drug.

"Over-the-counter drug" means a drug legally available by retail sale that does not require a prescription or consultation with a pharmacist or other health care professional.

Sec. 2.

[151.411] OVER-THE-COUNTER SALE OF IVERMECTIN AND HYDROXYCHLORIOQUINE.

Notwithstanding any law to the contrary, a registered pharmacy or a licensed pharmacist must offer ivermectin and hydroxychloroquine tablets suitable for human use for sale as an over-the-counter drug.
additions: "Over-the-counter drug" means a drug legally available by retail sale that does not require a prescription or consultation with a pharmacist or other health care professional.
